Message:
[SCSI] qla2xxx: Replace schedule_timeout().

From: Nishanth Aravamudan <nacc@us.ibm.com>

Replace schedule_timeout() with
msleep()/msleep_interruptible() as appropriate, to guarantee the task
delays as expected.
